items.lede: The option, which uses the front camera of the Uber driver's phone to record the entire drive, will show up as "Recorded Rides" in the app.
items.title: Uber now lets you book rides that record the drive by default

items.lede: Uber's Recorded Rides option is rolling out to Baltimore, Raleigh, Indianapolis and St. Louis first.
items.title: Uber now lets riders request drivers who are recording their trips
